mode disabling
When a ‘mode disabling’ is active, RTE and Basic Software Scheduler disables the activation of mode disabling dependent ExecutableEntitys. The ‘mode disabling’ is active during the mode that is referenced in the mode disabling dependency and during the transitions that enter and leave this mode. See also section 4.4.1.

targets.why: disables runnable activation during active mode
activation of mode disablings during transitions
disables schedulable entity when mode active
